_comment: SAMPLE: replace per client. Courts, groups, rates and the floor plan for the Courts & Rates section, the court map and the booking form. All rates below are SAMPLE rates.

groups.name: Indoor
groups.summary: Out of the sun and the rain. Four courts that play the same at 2 PM in July as they do at 10 PM in a downpour.

groups.name: Covered Outdoor
groups.summary: Open air under a roof. Two courts for players who like a breeze, with cover when the afternoon rain comes in.

_courtsComment: group = the zone the court sits in (indoor or outdoor); rate = which entry in 'rates' it is charged at; map = the court's top-left corner on the floor plan (see 'map').

courts.name: Court 1
courts.description: Good for early doubles before work, with off-peak rates on weekday mornings.

courts.name: Court 2
courts.description: Pair it with Court 1 when your group is too big for one court.

courts.name: Court 3
courts.description: Same lines and rate as the other indoor courts, kept clear of the rain.

courts.name: Court 4
courts.description: Bookable from the 6 AM slot through the last start at 10 PM.

courts.name: Court 5
courts.description: Open air under a roof, so a drizzle doesn't end the game.

courts.name: Court 6
courts.description: Same roof and rate as Court 5, a good pair for a group of eight.

map._comment: SAMPLE floor plan for the court map in Booking step 1. Units are roughly feet, (0,0) is the top-left corner. Every court is drawn court.width x court.length (pickleball is 20 x 44 ft) from its map.x / map.y. Zones are the labelled areas; 'group' must match a group id, and covered zones get a dashed roof line. The building is the solid outer wall; the entrance is a gap in its bottom wall, starting at entrance.x. When you move things, keep everything inside width x height.

rates._comment: SAMPLE rates: replace per client. Amounts are PHP per court, per hour. Off-peak applies to start hours >= fromHour and < toHour on the listed days (0 = Sunday).
